newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Deve Gowda to resign - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: India's Deve Gowda to resign - spokesman.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, who lost a crucial trust vote on his ten-month-old government, would resign, his spokesman told Reuters.
"He will resign today. He is meeting the president tonight," Gowda's official spokesman H.K. Dua said. "He may not recommend dissolution (of parliament) right away."
Gowda held an emergency meeting of his cabinet immediately after the vote.
"After the meeting, we will go to the president to tender the government's resignation," Foreign Minister Inder Kumar Gujral told Reuters shortly before the meeting began.
Lok Sabha Speaker P.A. Sangma said that of a total of 456 electronically counted votes, 292 went against the confidence motion, 158 were in favour, and there were six abstentions.
